summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by WeRide Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual general meeting (AGM) held on June 26, 2026. The filing discloses that all proposed resolutions were adopted, including the re-election of directors, granting a general unconditional mandate to issue or deal with additional Class A ordinary shares, and authorization to repurchase the company's own shares or ADSs. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is present. The filing serves as a standard periodic disclosure under the Securities Exchange Act.
